sections.title: Template .agents Maintenance Rules
sections.description: This file belongs in `.agents/docs/`, alongside `.agents/AGENTS.md`.

sections.title: Agents do not stage or commit changes
sections.description: Coding agents should leave git staging and commits to the maintainer so history and review boundaries stay human-controlled.

sections.title: `docs-search` stays canonical for `.agents/` knowledge; host-native search is not the default fallback policy
sections.description: Kit skills should not instruct agents to prefer each host product’s native workspace index or search first, with the `docs-search` Python tools only as fallback. Native search may complement general exploration but does not replace the explicit, scoped index contract for durable `.agents/` markdown.

sections.title: Docs tooling scripts resolve target from override, then nearest `.agents`
sections.description: Docs-search and docs-compile scripts should not assume git-root coupling; they first honor explicit target overrides, then discover the nearest `.agents` from the current working directory.

sections.title: GitHub Copilot as Rules-Based IDE Wiring tool
sections.description: Treat GitHub Copilot as an IDE wiring layer that routes agents to repo-local rules and skills, not as a second knowledge store.

sections.title: Decisions index
sections.description: One file per durable architectural or policy decision. New entries: follow [Entry shape](../MAINTENANCE.md#entry-shape) in `MAINTENANCE.md`, then add a row below.

sections.title: Integration guides belong in `docs/integrations/`, not `.agents/`
sections.description: Product-specific install and wiring guides live under root `docs/integrations/` so `.agents/` stays portable kit knowledge rather than vendor how-tos.

sections.title: Kit installation guidance lives in root docs
sections.description: Consumer-facing install, layout, and integration instructions belong in repository root `docs/` rather than inside `.agents/docs/`.

sections.title: Maintainer-only skills use `metadata.internal: true`
sections.description: Skills that are only for this repository’s maintenance must declare `metadata.internal: true` so portable installs do not surface them as kit skills.

sections.title: Optional `prior_session` in session `summary.json`
sections.description: Session bundles may record an optional `prior_session` pointer in `summary.json` to chain related closeouts without merging bundle folders.

sections.title: Maintainer plans live under `.agents/docs/plans/`, not `.agents/plans/`
sections.description: Canonical location for initiative and roadmap markdown is `.agents/docs/plans/` so plans are indexed by docs-search alongside decisions and troubleshooting.

sections.title: Regenerate `example/` when the portable kit or bootstrap changes
sections.description: When portable `.agents/` templates or bootstrap behavior change, refresh the generated `example/` tree so the illustrated consumer install stays accurate.

sections.title: Sessions directory: tracked README with ignored bundles
sections.description: Track only `.agents/sessions/README.md` in git while per-task bundle folders stay ignored so temporary closeout evidence does not pollute history.

sections.title: Shared integration patterns belong in `docs/integrations/patterns.md`
sections.description: Cross-vendor patterns that are not kit-specific belong in `docs/integrations/patterns.md` instead of duplicating them across agent trees.

sections.title: Single-tree architecture (`.agents/`)
sections.description: Canonical kit knowledge and portable skills live only under root `.agents/`; the `example/` tree is generated illustration, not a second source of truth.

sections.title: Use the Routing Pattern for agentic tool bootstrap files
sections.description: Bootstrap files for agentic tools should route to `.agents/AGENTS.md` and portable skills rather than embedding long forked guidance.

sections.title: Knowledge Index
sections.description: This file belongs in `.agents/docs/`.

sections.title: Add integration guides
sections.description: Roadmap for per-tool integration guides under docs/integrations/ so adopters can wire this kit into their workflow; one guide remains (vscode-extensions.md).

sections.title: Add knowledge search skill
sections.description: Roadmap for a knowledge-search skill that trains agents to search .agents/ markdown before loading large context windows.

sections.title: Add script tests for docs-search and docs-compile
sections.description: Add focused automated tests for docs-search and docs-compile scripts so consumer-deliverable behavior stays stable.

sections.title: Agent role guidance
sections.description: Document when and how to use coding, learning, and lint agent roles with the kit.

sections.title: Consumer-friendly upgrade path
sections.description: Reduce friction when upgrading the starter kit in an existing repo with clear merge guidance.

sections.title: Plans index
sections.description: One file per maintainer initiative or roadmap. New entries: follow the plan contract in [plans-as-first-class-artifacts.md](plans-as-first-class-artifacts.md), then add a row below.

sections.title: Integrate docs-search into learning-distill and knowledge-lint
sections.description: Make docs-search a first-class lookup step in distillation and lint workflows rather than only a post-write cache refresh.

sections.title: Guidance for out-of-repo knowledge trees
sections.description: Document overlays such as ~/.agents for personal or org policy and precedence versus in-repo .agents/.

sections.title: Plans as first-class artifacts
sections.description: Promote plans into a first-class, searchable, portable artifact type living under .agents/docs/plans/, with a canonical frontmatter schema, verified docs-search integration, lifecycle tooling, and a write-plan skill — superseding plan-rules-in-scaffold.

sections.title: Repo-centric wiki tooling
sections.description: Add lightweight compile, query, and visualize capabilities to the repo-local markdown knowledge layer without replacing the existing skill-based distillation workflow.

sections.title: Rules in the published kit
sections.description: Document a portable place for agent rules in the consumer .agents/ tree and how distillation routes content versus AGENTS.md, docs, and playbooks.

sections.title: Ship structure check script with the kit
sections.description: Make check-agents-structure.sh easy for consumers to run; keep check-publish maintainer-only for this starter repo.

sections.title: Wiki expansion for agent knowledge starter
sections.description: Extend the starter kit with a codebase-grounded wiki as a first-class knowledge store alongside skills and playbooks (not derived from them).

sections.title: Worked lifecycle example
sections.description: Add a compact end-to-end example from task-closeout through learning-distill without duplicating the structural example tree.

sections.title: Antigravity: Lessons learned aren't visible to teammate's agents
sections.description: Local-only research in Antigravity does not automatically become durable repo knowledge teammates can load; distill lessons into tracked `.agents/` files.

sections.title: Clean `git status` but you need touched paths for closeout
sections.description: After commits, the working tree is clean but **task-closeout** still needs an accurate list of paths touched in the session for the bundle record.

sections.title: Codex cannot write under `.agents/` during closeout or distill
sections.description: Codex runs may treat `.agents/` as read-only or require extra approval when creating session bundles or updating durable knowledge during workflows.

sections.title: Comparing greenfield `example/.agents/` to this repo’s root `.agents/`
sections.description: Consumers expect `example/.agents/` to mirror a portable install; diffs against root `.agents/` usually mean the example tree needs regeneration or a doc fix.

sections.title: Docs tooling resolves wrong project root in nested `example/` or global installs
sections.description: Docs tooling may target the wrong project when scripts infer only git root; this entry describes override-first plus nearest-`.agents` resolution and checks.

sections.title: Gemini CLI not following durable guidance
sections.description: Gemini CLI sessions may skip playbooks and `.agents/docs/` entries unless bootstrap files and explicit pointers are wired the way the kit expects.

sections.title: GitHub Copilot Chat context not in focus
sections.description: Copilot Chat may ignore `.agents/` guidance when routing files or editor context are not aligned with the repo’s documented bootstrap pattern.

sections.title: Hermes Agent–specific: Dual skill namespace (`skill_view` returns wrong file)
sections.description: Hermes may resolve `skill_view` against a different skill namespace than the repo’s `.agents/skills/` tree, returning unexpected stub content.

sections.title: Hermes Agent–specific: Suspected tool anomaly from a single weak run
sections.description: A single flaky tool invocation in Hermes should be validated against the real filesystem before promoting it as a durable repo-wide incident pattern.

sections.title: Troubleshooting index
sections.description: One file per recurring issue pattern. New entries: follow [Entry shape](../MAINTENANCE.md#entry-shape) in `MAINTENANCE.md`, then add a row below.

sections.title: Maintainer-only skill appears as a portable kit skill
sections.description: Maintainer automation placed under `.agents/skills/` without `internal: true` can be picked up by consumer installs; mark it internal or relocate it.

sections.title: Overlapping session bundles for one initiative
sections.description: Multiple `.agents/sessions/` folders may describe related work, complicating which bundle to distill or how `prior_session` links should be read.

sections.title: Remark or bulk Markdown rewrite touched unwanted paths
sections.description: Wide Markdown formatter runs can touch many files; this pattern explains how to restore only the intended paths without discarding unrelated work.

sections.title: Session Discovery Fails During Distillation or Closeout
sections.description: Closeout or distillation workflows sometimes report no session bundles even when work exists; this entry covers common glob and layout causes.

sections.title: Unexpected files under `.agents/sessions/` in git status
sections.description: Session bundles or stray files under `.agents/sessions/` can show up as tracked or modified when ignore rules and README expectations drift.

sections.title: Windows-to-WSL Tool Path Failures
sections.description: Agents running on Windows against a WSL workspace can fail file operations when paths cross the Windows/Linux boundary incorrectly.

sections.title: Zo UI skill discovery does not auto-show repo-local skills
sections.description: Skills installed via `npx skills add` into `.agents/skills/` (the canonical location) are not visible in Zo's Skills UI. The Skills panel does not show the kit skills until their `SKILL.md` files are manually copied into `/home/workspace/Skills/`.

sections.description: This directory belongs in `.agents/playbooks/`.

sections.title: Maintainer: Generate Example Folder
sections.description: Use this playbook to generate a complete, bootstrapped `example/` directory demonstrating a consumer installation of the starter kit.

sections.description: Use before publishing, tagging, or handing this starter kit to another repo.

sections.description: When writing an integration guide for an agent tool that has its own memory, skills, or knowledge systems (e.g., Hermes, OpenClaw), or for **IDE-integrated / rules-based** tools (e.g., Cursor project rules, Copilot instructions files).
